title: Nutrient Mechanism Relationships
description: Relationships between vitamins/minerals and biological mechanisms, used by NutrientResolver.php. Plays the same role for nutrients that bioactive-mechanisms.json plays for bioactives - both plug into the same mechanisms.json / body-systems-mechanisms.json hub.

nutrientId.description: Must match an id in vitamins.json (V-prefix) or minerals.json (M-prefix).

nutrient.description: Denormalised display name - must match the name of the referenced nutrient.

mechanismId.description: Must match an id in mechanisms.json.

mechanism.description: Denormalised display name - must match the name of the referenced mechanism.

basis.description: The physiological rationale for this relationship.

tier1Target.description: Whether this nutrient is a first-line recommended target for this mechanism.
